experiment: E13: views rendered as diagrams and exported to SVG in CATIA Magic (tools/cameo-scripts/exportViewDiagrams.groovy)
setup: Libraries and examples 01-05 loaded; the 9 views of examples/05-OnlineStoreViews.sysml requested; a bounded undo removes only the commands of this run

predictions.claim: No view has a diagram before the run (E07: loading and evaluating views creates none)
predictions.observation: 8 of 9 views had no diagram; OnlineStoreViews::architectureComponents already had one in this project (an earlier GUI 'General View' diagram, E07)

predictions.claim: Diagrams.createDiagram(view, Diagrams.getViewDefinition(view), false) creates a diagram for every view without an exception, inside the session
predictions.observation: Diagrams.createDiagram(view, getViewDefinition(view), false) created a 'SysMLv2:General View' diagram for every view (8 created, 1 reused)

predictions.claim: The whole run leaves exactly one undoable command named 'UML3 View Diagrams' on top of the history
predictions.observation: the run leaves one 'UML3 View Diagrams' command; a later 'Layout diagram' command came from the GUI (E14), not from the script

predictions.claim: DisplayExposedElements shows at least the elements of each view's recorded 'includes' (tests/cameo/view-predictions.json) and none of its 'excludes' as shapes
predictions.observation: shapes cover the recorded includes except exposed dependencies: DisplayExposedElements does not draw Dependency elements (checkoutUsesGateway in VW1; customerMapping/orderMapping in VW5); no exclude was drawn

predictions.claim: ImageExporter.export(diagram, SVG, file) writes a non-empty SVG for every view, and each 'includes' name occurs as text in the SVG
predictions.observation: ImageExporter.SVG draws text as outlines (no <text>, 4.9 MB); ExportParamsBuilder.setUseSVGTextTag(true) with InternalImageExporter.exportPaintableComponent writes <text> elements (82 KB), after which every include is found as text

predictions.claim: Undoing the 'UML3 View Diagrams' command removes the diagrams: afterwards Diagrams.getDiagram(view) is null again
predictions.observation: undoing 'UML3 View Diagrams' removed the created diagrams (Diagrams.getDiagram(view) null again)
